title: Classic French Casserole
description: A simple and comforting French-inspired casserole made with tender lettuce and a blend of flavors. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a casual gathering.
instructions: Chop the lettuce and set aside.
Prepare the casserole mix according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the casserole mix, chopped lettuce, and cubed French bread.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and the bread is crispy.
